# 04 · The Mission
Faith exported: convert foreign cities, be paid per foreign follower.
Wins by: The Widest Faith · *(planned)* The Ecumenical Council.

- Religion:

  - The Pulse of Bells — A proclamation reaches 4 hexes further and presses 20 faith harder.
  - Sacred Cartography (🐫 crossover) — A caravan carries your faith both ways along its route.

  - Congregation — +1 happiness for every 5 cities in the world that follow, up to 3.

## Æra IV
- Religion:
  - World Church — +1 happiness for every empire in the world that follows you.
  - The Long Prayer — +1 culture for every 4 citizens in the world who follow you.
- Deeds:
  - *(planned)* The Ecumenical Council — first faith followed by a world majority
  - The Widest Faith — At the close of the age, the empire whose faith is followed by the most citizens abroad.
  - Opus: foreign followers fund the faith pillar at a premium

## Gaps
One-channel all game: the Orders column is empty at every age, the wonder identity is
Hagia Sophia alone, and there is no great-person hook past the prophet.
